title: PricePreference - Pricing Module Data Models Reference

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the PricePreference data model. It belongs to the Pricing Module.

types.name: id
types.description: The ID of the price preference.

types.name: attribute
types.description: The attribute of the price preference. For example, `region_id`.

types.name: value
types.description: The value of the price preference. For example, `reg_123`.

types.name: is_tax_inclusive
types.description: Whether prices matching this preference include taxes.
